latestVersion.changelog:
video-maker-download 1.0.0

- Initial release for creating and downloading finished 1080p MP4 videos from clips or images.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB; all video processing done on cloud GPUs (1–2 minute turnaround).
- Automatic setup with user token or anonymous token generation; seamless session management.
- Simple commands for upload, export, credits check, and status updates through user-friendly prompts.
- Full instructions for export workflow, error handling, and session state management included.
- Clear API attribution and format support for all major media types.
